data.explanation: This is an invoice from a maintenance/gardening service for work done at your property: leaf clearing and gutter cleaning, totaling €321.30 including VAT. You are asked to pay within 10 days of receiving this invoice to the IBAN shown. The app will show the exact payment deadline. If you dispute the work or the amount, contact the provider directly using the phone or email given; there is no formal legal remedy procedure for this private invoice. Consider keeping this document, as craftsman services like this may be partly tax-deductible in Germany.
